title: Rigorix Policy & Configuration Model v1
description: v1 (2026-09-07) — grounded in rigorix-oss engine code (code is truth): sequence-policy rules from engine/src/sequence_policy/domain/rule.rs + config.rs (SequenceRule, StepPredicate, ParamPredicate, HistoryPredicate, RuleAction, SequencePolicyConfig, SafetyCaps) and the root rigorix.toml surface from engine/src/configuration/domain/config.rs (permission_mode, audit HMAC knobs). Root validates the OPERATOR-authored sequence-policy file (`[sequence_policy]` with `[[rules]]`, as consumed from .rigorix/sequence-policy.toml). The root config surface (rigorix.toml) is represented at $defs.rootConfigSurface for cross-tool alignment — permission_mode is a runtime-validated string (engine: Option<String>); known values documented. Enterprise policy_engine bundles must emit rule semantics in this shape (id/action/window/history/step predicates) — extension slots (approval policy, scope roles) are enterprise-only and land in the delta map.

fail_closed.description: Fail closed on config errors at plan time. Default true — a corrupt rule file must refuse the plan, never silently degrade.

rules.description: Ordered rule set (empty → no sequence gating).

sequenceRule.description: One operator-authored sequence rule. Match requires steps[i] to appear before steps[i+1] in the evaluated ordered step list.

description.description: Why the rule exists (surfaced to approvers / audit summaries).

window.description: Max index gap between first and last matched step. Absent = adjacent pair (gap 1).

action.description: Action on match (serde lowercase). Default promote.

history.description: R7: optional cross-run predicate — fires only when the within-run steps match AND the signed execution history shows a prior action by the same principal within the window. Absent = pre-R7 within-run behavior.

stepPredicate.description: Matches a tool name (exact or glob) plus optional parameter predicates.

tool.description: Tool name — exact or glob, e.g. "registration_remove", "registration_*".

params.description: Optional parameter predicates; empty means any parameters. Default empty.

paramPredicate.description: JSON pointer into the step's parameter object plus a value predicate (exact | glob | regex | equals_step).

pointer.description: JSON pointer into step parameters, e.g. "/event_id".

kind.description: How value is compared (serde): exact/glob/regex use `value`; equals_step (R8/ADR-014) compares to an earlier matched step's pointer value via `step`.

value.description: Expected value string. REQUIRED for exact/glob/regex (a missing value is a fail-closed config error — never a silent empty match); unused and omitted for equals_step.

step.description: R8/ADR-014: for kind=equals_step, the index (into the rule's steps[]) of the EARLIER matched step whose `pointer` value must equal this one.

historyPredicate.description: R7 cross-run predicate: a prior, already-completed run in the signed audit trail contained a conflicting action by the same principal, minutes apart.

prior_node.description: Glob over prior executed node names, e.g. "remove_attendance" or "remove_*".

same_principal.description: true → only history actions whose principal equals the current run's principal satisfy the predicate. Current run with no principal → predicate cannot match (never a false denial).

window_secs.description: Look-back window (seconds) over the signed history.

effect_key.description: R8/ADR-014: when true, additionally require a prior run whose envelope `effect_key` (one-way keyed hash, domain-supplied) equals the current step's `/effect_key`. Absent/false = principal+node only. A prior envelope without an effect key never matches.

safetyCaps.description: Engine safety caps bounding the rule engine (SequencePolicyConfig validation). Defaults: 100 rules / 8 step predicates / window 5 / 8 regex predicates / 604800s history look-back.

rootConfigSurface.description: rigorix.toml knobs that affect policy/enforcement/audit (engine/src/configuration/domain/config.rs). NOT exhaustive — additive-extensible; unknown keys ignored. Enterprise policy_engine alignment uses this surface for cross-tool identity (permission_mode semantics live in each runtime's enforcement layer).

permission_mode.description: Runtime-validated string; documented value: "workspace_write". Enforcement-layer interpretation differs OSS vs enterprise (delta map).

audit_hmac_key.description: HMAC key signing each local envelope. Never commit live values.
